title.zh: 储备推迟终结而不逃脱终结：Dependent 是零储备，储备可以是所持的条件，衰减的储备沿任意长的依存之链逐环界定共灭
title.en: A reserve defers the end and does not escape it: Dependent is the zero reserve, a reserve can be a held condition, and a decaying reserve bounds coextinction link by link along a chain of any length

claim.zh: 在依存网上，一个储备是每个形成的一个量：在该形成不被支持的一步上不上升，若它在该步活跃则下降（Carries）。零储备恰是 Dependent（carries_zero）：放宽“活动只在有支持处”就是允许正的储备，而不是让活动离开依存。储备可以是所持的条件：在平衡的流中，一个条件在持有者不被支持的步上没有给予、在持有者于该步活跃时被（参与该步的任何形成）取用，它的水平就是持有者的储备（Flow.carries_of_held）；持有者自己参与并从中取用时，储备是持有者自身的耗用（Flow.carries_of_own），如狐燃烧自己的脂肪。没有表示所持的条件时，储备是给定的量：两颗种子的依存网中没有任何条件承载它们（Seed.no_held、Viable.no_held）。依存失效而仍活跃的形成储备为正（Carries.pos），所以所持的条件承载形成时，可以把每个不被支持的依存移到所持的条件上、需要为一，水平、活动与汲取不变，这样读出的依存网由构造满足 Dependent（Web.redirect、Web.redirect_dependent；Famine.transformed_dependent）：在所持条件承载它的地方，滞后就是依存转化到所持的条件上。这是对储备的重新描述，不是关于展开的另一事实。两种读法在哪些事件侵蚀上不同：狐在第 1 步的事件按原读法侵蚀，按转化的读法不侵蚀（Famine.living_differs），所以读法的选择影响逐步读法的估值。储备推迟终结而不逃脱终结：从某步起不被支持的形成只在有限多步活跃（Carries.active_finitely），在任一段步上活跃的次数不超过开始时的储备（Carries.lasts；容量为 k 时不超过 k，Carries.lasts_within）。于是在没有回程而依存不变的损失之后（Carries.consumed_lasts），以及在它以正需要依存的体现关系项终结之后（Carries.coextinct_lasts），形成在支持之外至多再活跃其储备那么多次：滞后的终结与滞后的共灭；零储备之下，它们分别是 consumed_ends_when_fixed 与 coextinct。休眠同样推迟而不逃脱：不被支持时，形成只在有限多步生起（Carries.arising_finitely）；储备在休眠中也衰减时（种子的存活力，Decays），休眠在时间上也有界：从某步起不被支持的形成，经过与其储备一样多的步之后不再活跃（Carries.ends_within）。储备如此衰减时，共灭沿任意长的依存之链逐环有界：在 n 环的链上，被依存的关系项都体现、从第 T 步起每一个以正需要依存于前一个、第一个从 T 起不活跃时，直到第 n 个的每个关系项在它之前各环的储备过去之后不再活跃，每环的储备读于前一环终结之时（Carries.chain_ends，界为 Web.chainEnd）；零储备之下每一环都在 T 终结，即同时的共灭（chainEnd_zero）。储备不衰减时，以排中律为假设，链上每个关系项仍从某步起不活跃，但没有界（Carries.chain_ends_of_em）。食物链是有限的链；依存沿有界的等级上升时，如每个有限而没有依存之环的网，没有不止的链（Web.no_unending_chain），不止的链是对每个长度的情形。不以排中律为假设，那个终结之步一般地得不到：若每个从不被支持、有储备且活动可判定的形成都有一步之后不再活跃，即使它至多活跃一次，有限全知原则 LPO 就成立（Web.lpo_of_ending、Once；第十二次审查的探针）。见证：黑暗中的种子靠储备醒来两次，此后不再活跃，醒着的次数恰等于开始时的储备（Seed），它的储备不衰减（Seed.not_decays）；存活力为三的种子在第 2 步醒来，此后不再活跃，时间的界可以达到（Viable）；狐依存于体现的兔，兔终结后狐靠脂肪恰好多活两步，脂肪是流中狐自己燃烧的条件；把狐的依存读作转到脂肪上（水平、活动、汲取与流相同）时满足 Dependent（Famine）；每个关系项以需要一依存于前一个的链上，沿链的界可以达到：每个关系项靠储备恰好比前一个多活一步，没有储备时关系项 1 会在不被支持时活跃（Cascade）；同一级联截为三个关系项时，有限的形式给出关系项 2 从 chainEnd 2 = 3 起不活跃，界可以达到，而没有不止的链经过它（short_cascade）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: On webs, a reserve is an amount for each formation that does not rise across a step at which the formation is unsupported, and falls if the formation is active there (Carries). The zero reserve is exactly Dependent (carries_zero): relaxing ‘activity only where supported’ means allowing a positive reserve, not activity outside dependence. A reserve can be a held condition: in a balanced flow, a condition nothing gives to at steps at which its holder is unsupported, and which is taken from, by whatever takes part, when the holder is active there, has its standing as the holder's reserve (Flow.carries_of_held); where the holder itself takes part and takes from it, the reserve is the holder's own use (Flow.carries_of_own), as a fox burns its fat. Where no held condition is represented, the reserve is supplied: no condition of the two seeds' webs carries them (Seed.no_held, Viable.no_held). An active formation whose dependences fail has a positive reserve (Carries.pos), so where a held condition carries the formations, each unsupported dependence can be moved onto the held condition at need one, keeping levels, activity and drawing, and the web so read meets Dependent by construction (Web.redirect, Web.redirect_dependent; Famine.transformed_dependent): where a held condition carries it, lag is dependence transformed onto the held condition. This re-describes the reserve and is no further fact about the unfolding. The two readings differ in which events undermine: the fox's event at step one undermines as published and not when its dependence is moved onto its fat (Famine.living_differs), so the choice of reading bears on the stepwise valuation. A reserve defers the end and does not escape it: a formation unsupported from some step on is active only finitely often (Carries.active_finitely), and over any stretch at most as often as its reserve at the start (Carries.lasts; at most k with capacity k, Carries.lasts_within). So after a loss without return with the dependence unchanged (Carries.consumed_lasts), and after the end of an embodied relatum it depends on at a positive need (Carries.coextinct_lasts), a formation is active beyond its support at most as often as its reserve: lagged ending and lagged coextinction; with the zero reserve they are consumed_ends_when_fixed and coextinct. Dormancy defers in the same way: unsupported, a formation arises only finitely often (Carries.arising_finitely); where the reserve also decays while dormant (a seed's viability, Decays), dormancy is bounded in time as well: a formation unsupported from some step on is not active once as many steps have passed as its reserve (Carries.ends_within). Where the reserve so decays, coextinction runs down a chain of dependence of any length link by link: where, in a chain of n links, the relata depended on are embodied, each depends at a positive need on the one before it from step T on, and the first is inactive from T, each relatum up to the nth is inactive once the reserves of the links before it have passed, each read where the link before it ended (Carries.chain_ends, with the bound Web.chainEnd); with the zero reserve every link ends at T, coextinction at once (chainEnd_zero). Without decay, with excluded middle as a hypothesis, each relatum of the chain is still inactive from some step, with no bound (Carries.chain_ends_of_em). A food chain is a finite chain; where dependences climb a bounded rank, as in every finite web without a cycle of dependence, no chain goes on without end (Web.no_unending_chain), an unending chain being the case of every length. Without excluded middle that end step does not follow in general: if every formation never supported, with a carried reserve and decided activity, had a step after which it is never active, even one active at most once, the limited principle of omniscience LPO would hold (Web.lpo_of_ending, Once; the twelfth review's probe). Witnesses: a seed in the dark wakes twice on its reserve and never again, awake exactly as often as its reserve at the start (Seed), its reserve not decaying (Seed.not_decays); a seed with a viability of three wakes at step 2 and never after, attaining the bound in time (Viable); a fox depending on the embodied hare outlives it by exactly two steps on its fat, a condition in the flow that the fox burns itself, and read with the fox's dependence moved onto the fat, with the same levels, activity, drawing and flow, it meets Dependent (Famine); in a chain in which each relatum depends at need one on the one before it, the bound along the chain is attained: each relatum outlives the one before it by exactly one step on its reserve, while without the reserve relatum 1 would be active unsupported (Cascade); the same cascade cut to three relata has relatum 2 inactive from chainEnd 2 = 3 by the finite form, attaining the bound, while no unending chain runs through it (short_cascade). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: Carries 与 Dependent 一样是表示前提：哪个量承载一个形成、它在形成不被支持时不上升，由应用给出。Carries.lasts 另需每步“形成是否活跃”可判定（定理的假设，不是公理）。
hypotheses.en: Carries, like Dependent, is a representational premise: which amount carries a formation, and that it does not rise while the formation is unsupported, are supplied by the application. Carries.lasts also needs whether the formation is active at each step to be decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).

hypotheses.zh: Decays 是另一个表示前提，只用于 ends_within 与 chain_ends：储备在形成不被支持而为正的每一步都下降，不论形成是否活跃。
hypotheses.en: Decays is a further representational premise, used only for ends_within and chain_ends: the reserve falls across every step at which the formation is unsupported and the reserve is positive, whether or not the formation is active.

hypotheses.zh: carries_of_held 需要流平衡依存网；持有者不被支持的步上没有给予所持的条件；持有者在不被支持而活跃的步上，所持的条件被参与该步的形成取用（不必是持有者自己；carries_of_own 要求持有者自己参与并取用）。哪个条件是一个形成所持的，由应用给出。
hypotheses.en: carries_of_held needs the flow to balance the web; nothing gives to the held condition at steps at which its holder is unsupported; at each step at which the holder is unsupported and active, the held condition is taken from by the formations taking part (not necessarily the holder; carries_of_own asks the holder itself to take part and take). Which condition a formation holds is supplied by the application.

hypotheses.zh: consumed_lasts 用没有回程的损失与不变的依存（同 consumed_ends_when_fixed）；coextinct_lasts 用从体现关系项终结之步起以正需要的依存，Embodied 在一类读法的同一对应下读（见 life-as-condition-of-life）。
hypotheses.en: consumed_lasts uses a loss without return and an unchanged dependence (as consumed_ends_when_fixed); coextinct_lasts uses dependence at a positive need from the step at which the embodied relatum has ended, Embodied being read under the one-kind identification (see life-as-condition-of-life).

hypotheses.zh: Web.redirect 与 redirect_dependent 需要每步“形成是否被支持”可判定（定理的假设，不是公理）。
hypotheses.en: Web.redirect and redirect_dependent need whether a formation is supported at each step to be decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).

hypotheses.zh: chain_ends 与 chain_ends_of_em 另用：n 环的链上被依存的关系项（前 n 个）都体现；从第 T 步起前 n 环每一环以正需要依存于前一环（逐环是 coextinct_lasts 的前提）；第一环从 T 起不活跃。结论对直到第 n 个的关系项成立；不止的链是对每个 n 的情形。chain_ends_of_em 不用 Decays，而以排中律为假设（不是公理）。
hypotheses.en: chain_ends and chain_ends_of_em further use, for a chain of n links: the relata depended on (the first n) embodied; each of the n links depending at a positive need on the one before it from step T on (link by link, the premise of coextinct_lasts); and the first inactive from T. The conclusion holds of the relata up to the nth; an unending chain is the case of every n. chain_ends_of_em does not use Decays and takes excluded middle as a hypothesis, not an axiom.

correspondence.zh: 开放纲领自 P6 起列出“放宽 Dependent（缓冲、储备、滞后）”；共灭的范围排除种子库、储备与休眠（life-as-condition-of-life）；generation-is-replenishment 的下一步列出活动与水平不同步。按非二元方法，在流与所持条件被表示的地方，储备不是新的原语：它是形成所持的一个条件的水平，缓冲与滞后是对所持之物的依存，可以读作依存的转化（P6 的 consumed_continues_transformed）；没有表示所持条件时，储备是给定的量（Seed、Viable）。两种读法改变哪些事件是 living，所以在所持条件被表示的地方，用哪种读法是影响估值的对应前提。推迟而不逃脱与 unceasing-generation-needs-renewal 的“替代推迟终结而不逃脱”（substitution_defers、Relay）是同一模式，这里推迟的是所持的条件。物理内容是所持之物有限。脂肪、种子库与储蓄是应用的例子，不是定理的内容。沿依存之链：每一环的储备读于前一环终结之时，支持期间的补充已计入界中，不需另设前提；零储备之下，这是 coextinct 在一条链上跨步的情形（P31）。
correspondence.en: Since P6 the open programme has listed ‘relax Dependent (buffers, reserves, lag)’; coextinction's scope excluded seed banks, reserves and dormancy (life-as-condition-of-life); generation-is-replenishment's next step listed activity and standing out of step. Following the nondual method, where a flow and a held condition are represented, a reserve is not a new primitive: it is the standing of a condition the formation holds, buffer and lag are dependence on what is held, and they can be read as a transformation of dependence (P6's consumed_continues_transformed); where no held condition is represented, the reserve is a supplied amount (Seed, Viable). The two readings change which events are living, so where a held condition is represented, which reading is used is a correspondence premise bearing on the valuation. Deferring without escaping is the pattern of unceasing-generation-needs-renewal's ‘substitution defers the end without escaping it’ (substitution_defers, Relay), here deferring on a held condition. The physical content is that what is held is finite. Fat, seed banks and savings are examples of application, not content of the theorems. Along a chain of dependence, each reserve is read where the link before it ended, so replenishment while supported is counted in the bound and needs no further premise; with the zero reserve this is coextinct along a chain, across steps (P31).

detail.zh: 复用 Supported、Dependent 与损失的结局；零储备恰是 Dependent，consumed_lasts 推广 consumed_ends_when_fixed。
detail.en: Reuses Supported, Dependent and the outcomes of a loss; the zero reserve is exactly Dependent, and consumed_lasts generalizes consumed_ends_when_fixed.

output.zh: 活动只在有支持处；损失之后的三种结局。
output.en: Activity only where supported; three outcomes of a loss.

input.zh: 活动可以越过支持，次数至多是所持的储备。
input.en: Activity can go beyond support, at most as often as what is held allows.

conditions.zh: Carries；没有回程的损失与不变的依存。
conditions.en: Carries; a loss without return with the dependence unchanged.

detail.zh: 复用 falls_finitely：从某步起不上升的储备只下降有限多次。
detail.en: Reuses falls_finitely: a reserve that never rises from some step on falls only finitely often.

output.zh: 从某步起不上升的观测量只下降有限多次。
output.en: An observable that never rises from some step on falls only finitely often.

input.zh: 不被支持的形成只在有限多步活跃。
input.en: An unsupported formation is active only finitely often.

conditions.en: Carries; unsupported from some step on.

detail.zh: 复用 Embodied；coextinct_lasts 推广 coextinct 到有储备的情形。
detail.en: Reuses Embodied; coextinct_lasts generalizes coextinct to formations with a reserve.

output.zh: 体现的关系项终结每个依存链到达它的形成（Dependent 之下）。
output.en: An embodied relatum's ending ends every formation whose chain reaches it (under Dependent).

input.zh: 有储备时，依存于它的形成在它终结后至多再活跃其储备那么多次。
input.en: With a reserve, a formation depending on it is active after its end at most as often as its reserve.

conditions.en: Embodied; dependence at a positive need; Carries.

detail.zh: 复用流、平衡、给予与取用；储备是流中所持条件的水平。
detail.en: Reuses flows, balance, giving and taking; a reserve is the standing of a held condition in a flow.

output.zh: 平衡的流：水平的变化恰是取用与给予之差。
output.en: Balanced flows: a level changes by exactly what is taken and given.

input.zh: 所持的条件承载其持有者。
input.en: A held condition carries its holder.

conditions.zh: 平衡；不被支持时没有给予；活跃时取用。
conditions.en: Balance; no giving while unsupported; taking while active.

detail.zh: 同一模块陈述水平越过活动的情形：种子在休眠时被给予它的水平（Provisioned），醒来不需要给予（Sleeper）。
detail.en: The same module states standing beyond activity: a seed is given its standing while dormant (Provisioned), and waking needs nothing given (Sleeper).

detail.zh: 替代推迟终结而不逃脱（substitution_defers）是同一模式。
detail.en: Substitution defers the end without escaping it (substitution_defers): the same pattern.

detail.zh: 黑暗中的种子不满足 Dependent，储备承载它：它生起两次后不再活跃，醒着的次数恰等于开始时的储备，界可以达到（Seed.seed）。
detail.en: A seed in the dark fails Dependent and its reserve carries it: it arises twice and is never active again, awake exactly as often as its reserve at the start, so the bound is attained (Seed.seed).

detail.zh: 狐依存于体现的兔，不满足 Dependent；脂肪是流中的条件并承载狐，兔终结后狐恰好多活两步（脂肪的两单位）；把狐的依存读作转到脂肪上时满足 Dependent（Famine.famine）；两种读法下狐在第 1 步的事件一个侵蚀、一个不侵蚀（Famine.living_differs）。
detail.en: A fox depending on the embodied hare fails Dependent; its fat, a condition in the flow, carries it, and it outlives the hare by exactly two steps, the fat's two units; read with the fox's dependence moved onto the fat, it meets Dependent (Famine.famine); the fox's event at step one undermines under one reading and not under the other (Famine.living_differs).

detail.zh: 储备不衰减时，休眠在时间上没有界：Seed 的储备在休眠中保持（Seed.not_decays）；存活力每步下降的种子在第 2 步醒来，第 3 步起不再活跃，ends_within 的界可以达到（Viable.viable）。
detail.en: Without decay, dormancy is not bounded in time: Seed keeps its reserve while dormant (Seed.not_decays); a seed whose viability falls at every step wakes at step 2 and is inactive from step 3, attaining the bound of ends_within (Viable.viable).

detail.zh: 储备不必是所持条件的水平：两颗种子的依存网中所有水平为零，没有条件承载它们，储备是给定的量（Seed.no_held、Viable.no_held）。
detail.en: A reserve need not be a held condition's standing: every level of the two seeds' webs is zero, no condition carries them, and the reserve is a supplied amount (Seed.no_held, Viable.no_held).

detail.zh: 沿依存链的界可以达到：关系项 x 活跃至第 x 步，x+1 以需要一依存于 x，储备至第 x 步为一；第 k 个关系项在第 k 步仍活跃，chainEnd k 为 k+1；没有储备时关系项 1 在第 1 步活跃而不被支持，Dependent 不成立（Cascade.cascade）。
detail.en: The bound along a chain is attained: relatum x is active through step x, relatum x + 1 depends on x at need one, and the reserve is one through step x; relatum k is still active at step k with chainEnd k equal to k + 1, and without the reserve relatum 1 is active unsupported at step one, failing Dependent (Cascade.cascade).

detail.zh: 把“只在有限多步活跃”化为终结之步需要全知：一个从不被支持的形成在 s 的第一个 true 处活跃，储备承载它，活动可判定且至多一次；若每个这样的形成都有终结之步，LPO 成立（Web.lpo_of_ending、Once）。
detail.en: Turning ‘active only finitely often’ into an end step needs omniscience: a formation never supported, active at the first true of s, carried by its reserve, with decided activity holding at most once; if every such formation had an end step, LPO would hold (Web.lpo_of_ending, Once).

limitations.zh: 不含伦理谓词；Carries 与所持的条件是表示前提；结论约束的是从某步起不被支持的形成，不约束支持是否回来：储备若接上回来的支持，可以承载活动不止；Carries 之下休眠不耗用储备，休眠的时间只在另设 Decays 时有界；数量的界需要活动可判定；沿依存链的滞后共灭的界只在储备衰减时陈述：储备不衰减时一环的终结之步没有界，以排中律为假设只得每环终结（chain_ends_of_em），不以排中律为假设，把“只在有限多步活跃”化为终结之步一般地蕴含 LPO（lpo_of_ending），所以核心不陈述它；沿到达一个关系项的每条有限链的界由 chain_ends 给出，图上取各链最小界的形式没有陈述；一般地构造转化的读法需要“是否被支持”可判定；carries_of_held 计入参与者的任何取用，不只是持有者的（审查的 Larder 探针）；两种读法在 living 上不同，用哪一种属于对应前提；见证都是最小见证。
limitations.en: Contains no ethical predicate; Carries and the held condition are representational premises; the conclusions bind a formation unsupported from some step on, not whether support returns: a reserve that bridges to returning support can carry activity without end; under Carries dormancy uses no reserve, and the time of dormancy is bounded only under the further premise Decays; the quantitative bound needs decidable activity; lagged coextinction along chains of dependence is bounded only where the reserve decays: without decay a link's end step has no bound, excluded middle as a hypothesis giving only that each link ends (chain_ends_of_em), and without it turning ‘active only finitely often’ into an end step implies LPO in general (lpo_of_ending), so the core does not state it; the bound along each finite chain reaching a relatum is given by chain_ends, while the form taking the least bound over the chains of a graph is not stated; the general construction of the transformed reading needs decidable support; carries_of_held counts any uptake by the formations taking part, not only the holder's (the review's Larder probe); the two readings differ in living, and which is used is a correspondence premise; the witnesses are minimal.
